text:
anya: Kicking off coordinated rollout for api@2.4.1 + runtime@1.9.0-rc3 + router@3.2.0 + console@5.1.0. Target change window: 2026-03-25 02:00-03:30 UTC. Posting compatibility notes, gating and rollback criteria below.

matt: Quick compatibility callout — runtime rc3 switches KV eviction header from `X-KV-Mode: evict` -> `X-KV-Mode: evict-v2`. API layer MUST accept both values during the transition (fallback to old string).

jihoon: Router 3.2.0 adds `route-md5` in response headers for route checksum. Console will read that to show routing diffs. Need schema compat test before canary.

rachel: Drafting release notes: mention header change, opt-in runtime feature flag RUNTIME_KV_V2, and steps for rolling back. Will open PR to docs in ~30m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks OK — images signed, manifests linted, dependency graph locked. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 10m -> 25% for 20m -> 100% for 30m. Orchestrated region sequence: EU -> US -> APAC. To start: `/deploy coordinated-cross-sync --window 2026-03-25T02:00Z`

anya: Rollback criteria (agreed): p95 latency increase > 200ms vs baseline OR absolute error rate increase > 2% OR KV miss rate uplift > 10% => immediate rollback. Also: route-md5 checksum divergence > 0.1% between router replicas => pause and investigate.

jihoon: Suggest a temporary soft-pin: api@2.4.1-postfix for 48h; router pinned at 3.2.0 but with a fallback tag 3.1.8. Runtime has a hotpatch path back to 1.9.0-stable. Ops OK with those pins?

matt: SRE runbook updated with CLI steps to cut traffic and force router fallback. Added step numbers and expected commands. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cross-sync (internal).

sre-bot: sre-bot: monitors deployed: latency_p95, 5xx_rate, kv_miss_rate, route_md5_delta. Alerts to #incidents and @oncall if thresholds crossed. Thresholds set to p95 +200ms, 5xx x3 baseline, kv_miss +10%.

anya: Let's run EU canary first only. Console will be behind feature flag `show_route_md5=false` by default so we don't surface half-baked values. We'll flip console in the final 100% step.

rachel: PR #4823 opened for release notes + changelog + rollback playbook. Includes upgrade matrix and sample client header snippet:```http
GET /v1/model/health
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-KV-Mode: evict-v2, evict
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging cutover scheduled at 1736750400 (2026-03-25 02:00:00 UTC). Allocation tickets created for router pool and runtime pool. Reply with :thumbsup: to approve automated start.

matt: :thumbsup:

anya: OK starting the coordination doc in the release tracker and tagging infra/sre/console/runtime teams. Will call the preflight 10m prior. Thanks everyone.
